shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere: book covers and spines are plain solid colors, any page or screen shows only faint, unreadable lines, signs are blank. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the person, both hands and the object of the action inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.action: The action is the most obvious thing in the photo: the camera is at eye level a few steps away, the face is fully visible in three-quarter view and in sharp focus, and the person is seen from the head to the waist or lower, with the hands and the object clearly visible. The person is busy with the action and does not look at the camera.
shared_prompts.night: It is clearly NIGHT: every window shows a dark blue-black night sky, and the only strong light is a warm desk lamp that lights the face, the hands, the open book and the notebook; the rest of the room falls into soft shadow. No daylight anywhere.
shared_prompts.study: Studying is unmistakable: a thick open textbook lies flat on the table, its pages showing only faint grey lines, and beside it an open notebook; the person writes notes in the notebook with a pen, eyes on the textbook. There is NO laptop, NO computer, NO tablet and NO phone anywhere.

assets.item: How often do you study at night? I usually study at night. / Diego usually studies at night. / He usually studies at night.

reference_file.observed_description: Diego (dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, burgundy button shirt) sits at a wooden kitchen table and bites a red apple, a white bowl of fruit in front of him (A1+ 1.2).

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Diego. Keep his face, dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, skin tone and build exactly, and his burgundy button shirt. Create a new photograph in his small study at home late at night: Diego sits at a plain wooden desk by a window and studies. The textbook has a plain dark-green cover; a yellow highlighter lies beside the notebook; a mug and a small houseplant stand at the far end of the desk, and a bookshelf of plain-colored books is softly visible in the shadow behind him, so the room reads as a home.

assets.item: How often do you study at night? I sometimes study at night. / Ana sometimes studies at night. / She sometimes studies at night.

reference_file.observed_description: Ana (long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin, sage-green overshirt over a white top, jeans) sits on a light-grey sofa and reads an open hardcover book (A1+ 1.2).

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Ana. Keep her face, long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin and build exactly, and her sage-green overshirt over a white top. Create a new photograph in a quiet public library late at night, NOT a home: Ana sits alone at one end of a long wooden reading table with several empty wooden chairs, and studies. Tall wooden bookshelves full of books with plain-colored spines rise behind her, and a tall library window at one side shows the dark night sky. The textbook has a plain blue cover.

assets.item: How often do you work at home? I always work at home. / Sofia always works at home. / She always works at home.

reference_file.observed_description: Sofia (long curly dark hair, warm brown skin, white blouse under a bright blue blazer) writes in a large notebook at a wooden desk by a bright window in her home study, a stack of her dark-red books beside her (A1+ 1.2).

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Sofia. Keep her face, long curly dark hair, warm brown skin and build exactly, and her white blouse under her bright blue blazer, with no badge and no card. Create a new photograph in her bright home study on a sunny morning, in DAYLIGHT: Sofia sits at a wooden desk by a big sunny window and works on an open silver laptop, both hands on the keyboard, eyes on the screen, which faces away from the camera. The stack of her four plain dark-red books stands on the desk beside the laptop, with a coffee mug. Home is obvious: behind her a comfortable armchair with a cushion, a soft rug and a large houseplant. There is NO textbook and NO notebook. No framed pictures of people.

assets.item: How often do you work at home? I never work at home. / Luis never works at home. / He never works at home.

reference_file.observed_description: Luis (short dark curly hair, clean-shaven, warm medium-brown skin, navy crew-neck T-shirt) drinks coffee from a white mug at a wooden table in his bright kitchen (A1+ 1.2).

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Luis. Keep his face, short dark curly hair, clean-shaven face, warm medium-brown skin and build exactly. Create a new photograph of Luis at work, far from home: he is the driver of a city bus on a sunny morning. The camera stands inside the empty bus near the front door, a few steps beside and slightly behind the driver's seat, at his eye level. Luis sits in the driver's seat in a plain navy short-sleeved polo shirt with no badge or logo, both hands on the large steering wheel, eyes on the road ahead through the big windshield, which shows a sunny city street with trees. A row of empty blue passenger seats and a yellow grab pole are softly visible. The bus is clearly a bus and clearly not a home. The route sign and every screen are blank.
